name: accounts
description: Accounts table in the new platform. Strongly typed; constraints are enforced by the database.

fields.name: external_ref
fields.description: Stable business key carried over from the legacy system: 'C-' plus five digits, upper case.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Lower-case e-mail address; null when unknown.

fields.name: phone_e164
fields.description: Phone number in E.164 format; null when unknown.

fields.name: balance_cents
fields.description: Account balance in integer cents (negative = credit owed).

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the account.
